android.desc:
●Season 9 2026: Vampires vs Werewolves will make you choose your faction and fight for dominance in the Fang Wars in-game event joined by Leader’s Kill Confirmed mode, player-voted Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints in the new Battle Pass, the Grav Assault Rifle, and more!

● New Arcade Mode: Leader’s Kill Confirmed
In the brand-new Leader's Kill Confirmed mode, soldiers will randomly transform into Goliath Leaders and battle it out. Goliath Leaders possess powerful combat abilities, and picking up Dog Tags grants extra points. ● The new Nuketown will replace the old Nuketown and enter the Ranked map pool. The old Nuketown will be removed at that time. 

● AddedNew levels added to the Honkai Impact 3rd collaboration mode, Honkai: Gleaming Front. Come show everyone your ultimate firepower!

● A new Weapon, Grav, is here! A fully automatic rifle with high bullet velocity. Equip attachments to increase its damage.

Call of Duty: Mobile Season 9: Vampires vs Werewolves

[New Arcade Mode: Leader’s Kill Confirmed]
In the brand-new Leader's Kill Confirmed mode, soldiers will randomly transform into Goliath Leaders and battle it out. Goliath Leaders possess powerful combat abilities, and picking up Dog Tags grants extra points.

[Matchmaking & Ranked Optimization Ranked Festival]
The Ranked Festival is about to begin. Earn an extra Legendary Medal and sprint toward this year's Elite Mission Legacy Weapon!
Extra First Wins and extra Construct Rewards will go live at the same time. Don't miss out!

[New Weapon: Grav]
A fully automatic rifle with high bullet velocity. Equip attachments to increase its damage.

[Themed Event: Fang Wars]
Help your chosen faction accumulate faction points to earn the epic weapon Type 25 - Lone Wolf or RUS-79U - Hunting Tools, plus a Legendary Calling Card that awaits you!

[Fistful of Action]
The Street Fighter collaboration is making a comeback! Log in and join the battle to claim exclusive rewards!

[Call of the Dead]
The summoning returns. Soldiers can log in during the event to claim a custom theme music track. Complete more missions to earn epic rewards including K9 Unit - Fantasma and more!
